title: Clinical findings at offset 2,500: designations and properties at depth
exercises: includeDesignations + property=parent,inactive,moduleId at offset 2,500 (inside the current FHIRsmith release's 3,000-code limit) and 100,000
why: Mixed: the engine reaches any offset in O(1), so the cost is the 500 rows it builds; main walks to the offset first.
stresses: 500 rows x ~4 designations x 3 properties, at depth

expectedDifferences.reason: tx.fhir.org ignores the $expand property parameter and ValueSet.compose.property: no requested properties are returned (probed on /r4 and /r5, valueCode and valueString, 2026-11-01); it only adds a status property to non-active LOINC codes.
